nodes.text: Steven didn't want to leave his house, didn't want to make the journey outside. He was still tired and stiff from falling asleep like he did, twisted in a tight spot.

He dreamt of being at a summer camp for smart kids, where the kids did science experiments and played on computers, only he just wanted to go swimming and sing around the camp fire and be a kid. They had plans they made last Sunday night and looked forward to all school week.
They had parties to go to, raves to track down, energy to burn.
